info.title: SeanBlog Frame Backend API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the SeanBlog Frame backend. The project uses a single-administrator model: public endpoints do not require authentication, while /api/admin/* endpoints require a valid Auth.js session cookie.

adminSession.name: authjs.session-token
adminSession.description: Auth.js administrator session cookie. Local development usually uses authjs.session-token; HTTPS production may use __Secure-authjs.session-token.

ArticleUpdateInput.description: Article update payload. All fields are optional for PATCH.

CategoryUpdateInput.description: Category update payload. All fields are optional for PATCH.

TagUpdateInput.description: Tag update payload. All fields are optional for PATCH.

Unauthorized.description: Administrator session is missing or invalid.

get.description: Auth.js managed sign-in endpoint for the single administrator account.

200.description: Auth.js sign-in page or response. Content type is managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Returns the Auth.js provider registry. Current backend exposes the Credentials provider for the single administrator account.

200.description: Provider registry response managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Auth.js managed error endpoint/page used for authentication failures.

200.description: Auth.js error page or response. Content type is managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Returns the current Auth.js session payload when a valid session cookie is present.

200.description: Current session object or an empty/null session response managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Returns a CSRF token used by Auth.js form posts.

200.description: CSRF token response managed by Auth.js.

post.description: Signs out the current administrator session. Auth.js may require a CSRF token depending on request mode.
Auth.js Credentials Provider callback. Submit administrator credentials (`username=admin`, `password`) using Auth.js form semantics, typically with a CSRF token.

200.description: Credentials callback response managed by Auth.js.

201.description: Created comment, pending moderation by default.
